evidence.notes: Database.convertLead method family converts single and list LeadConvert values through local lead conversion.
Single LeadConvert with AccessLevel runs through local lead conversion.
Single LeadConvert with allOrNothing=false runs through local lead conversion.
Single LeadConvert with allOrNothing and AccessLevel runs through local lead conversion.
Single LeadConvert with DMLOptions and AccessLevel accepts the option object and runs local conversion.
List LeadConvert overload returns ordered LeadConvertResult rows.
List LeadConvert overload with AccessLevel returns ordered LeadConvertResult rows.
List LeadConvert overload with allOrNothing=false returns ordered LeadConvertResult rows.
List LeadConvert overload with allOrNothing and AccessLevel returns ordered LeadConvertResult rows.
List LeadConvert overload with DMLOptions and AccessLevel accepts the option object and returns ordered rows.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseConvertLeadOverloadsTest { private static Integer seq = 0; private static Database.LeadConvert nextConvert() { seq++; Lead lead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Lead', LastName = 'Convert ' + seq, Company = 'Company ' + seq, Status = 'Open'); insert lead; Database.LeadConvert convert = new Database.LeadConvert(); convert.setLeadId(lead.Id); convert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); convert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); return convert; } private static void assertConverted(Database.LeadConvertResult result) { System.assert(result.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.getLeadId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.getAccountId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.getContactId()); } @isTest static void singleOverloadsConvertLocally() { Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.optAllOrNone = false; assertConverted(Database.convertLead(nextConvert(), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); assertConverted(Database.convertLead(nextConvert(), false)); assertConverted(Database.convertLead(nextConvert(), false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); assertConverted(Database.convertLead(nextConvert(), opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); } @isTest static void listOverloadsConvertLocally() { Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.optAllOrNone = false; List<Database.LeadConvertResult> bare = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{nextConvert(), nextConvert()}); System.assertEquals(2, bare.size()); assertConverted(bare[0]); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> access = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{nextConvert()}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, access.size()); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> allOrNothing = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{nextConvert()}, false); System.assertEquals(1, allOrNothing.size()); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> both = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{nextConvert()}, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, both.size()); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> options = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{nextConvert()}, opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, options.size()); assertConverted(options[0]); } }
